whoItsFor: Enterprise knowledge, legal, HR, and research teams that need a self-hosted knowledge base where facts carry dates and an audit trail, and that can run offline. Developers who want AI agents to query that knowledge base over MCP may also use it.
useCases: Tracing which contract terms applied on a given date, through amendments that close earlier terms
Answering who held a role in a given period and what the knowledge base believed at the time
Letting agents such as Claude Desktop or Cursor query a knowledge base over MCP with scoped permissions

requirements.runtime: Docker (local development also needs Rust 1.85+, Node 20+, pnpm)
